message.content:
This editorial illustration depicts a man viewed from behind standing before a reflective surface. He wears a short-sleeved blue button-down shirt and light-colored trousers. His reflection shows a man with short hair and glasses perched on his forehead, wearing a red vest with three horizontal black stripes over a red shirt. This reflected figure smiles slightly. In the foreground, three strands of bright yellow tape are stretched horizontally and diagonally across the scene. The tape displays repetitive black text: "DILARANG MELINTAS GARIS POLISI", "DO NOT CROSS", and "POLICE LINE".

Above the scene, the large red word "TEMPO" is centered. At the top, text reads "Bukti Pelanggaran Anwar Usman H.32" and "Maju-Mundur Pensiun Dini PLTU Batu Bara H.88". In the center, large white text states "SUAP DAHULU, BEKING KEMUDIAN". Below this, a block of smaller white text mentions "Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi," "Eddy Hiariej," and "H.74." A barcode, QR code, and date "6-12 NOVEMBER 2023" are located in the upper right. The background features brown and tan interior walls.
